articles.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
articles.snippet: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: Visa Widens Stablecoin Payouts via Zerohash Rails
articles.snippet: Eligible Visa Direct clients can now prefund accounts and send payouts in stablecoins, expanding Visa's latest push to bring blockchain-based payments into its global network.
